formative_worksheets.title: Mid-Unit Multiplication Check-In
formative_worksheets.when_to_use: After Lesson 3, before Lesson 4. A 10-minute check on B2.2 + B2.6.
formative_worksheets.student_learning_goal: I can recall multiplication facts of 2, 5, 10 and represent any fact up to 10×10 as an array.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can recall multiplication facts of 2, 5, 10 and represent any fact up to 10×10 as an array.
header.character_watermark: Maya in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

image_placeholders.description: A 12-cell fluency table in B&W. Mix of ×2, ×5, ×10 facts plus 4 tricky facts (6×7, 8×7, 9×6, 7×8).
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q1_FLUENCY: keywords (fluency, facts) name what the table shows.

prompts.prompt: Build an array for 7×8 and write the related division.
prompts.visual_layout: Middle. A blank array grid plus space for the equations.

image_placeholders.description: A blank 10×10 array grid in B&W with space below for two equations.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q2_ARRAY: keywords (array, division) name what the grid asks for.

prompts.answer_key: 7×8=56 (or 8×7=56) — array of 7 rows × 8 columns. Related division: 56÷7=8 and 56÷8=7.

prompts.prompt: How are you feeling? Circle the face.
prompts.visual_layout: Bottom. Three faces in a row. Below each: 'GOT IT!', 'ALMOST!', 'TRY AGAIN!'.

image_placeholders.description: Three round face icons in a row. Smile, neutral, frown.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q3_FACES: keywords (got, almost, try) name the labels.

formative_worksheets.teacher_notes: Administer between Lesson 3 and Lesson 4. Score: 12/12 fluency + correct array = ready for Lesson 4. Below = small-group reteach.

reflection_sheet.title: My Times Table Toolkit Reflection
reflection_sheet.student_learning_goal: I can think about what I learned this week.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can think about what I learned this week.
header.character_watermark: Tony, Maya, Pixel together with a Junior certificate. Small (~1.5in tall combined).

prompts.prompt: How do you feel about being a Junior Times Table Toolkit Operator? Circle one.

image_placeholders.description: Three rating ovals in B&W. 1 star, 2 stars, 3 stars. Labels: 'Just starting', 'Mostly got it', 'I am a Toolkit Operator!'
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_STARS: keywords (stars) name the rating ovals.

prompts.prompt: Did you do these things? Circle YES or NO.

image_placeholders.description: 4-row YES/NO table in B&W. Each row: question on left, YES/NO ovals on right.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_YN_TABLE: keywords (yes, no) name the response bubbles.

options: I built arrays for any fact

prompts.visual_layout: Four tool icons in a row.

image_placeholders.description: Four tool icons in B&W: base-ten blocks, multiplication chart, fraction strips, ratio table. Each ~1in × 1in with selection bubble below.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_FAV_BOX: keywords (table) name the four tools.

image_placeholders.description: Three tricky-moment cards in a row in B&W. Card A: standard algorithm with regrouping. Card B: a tricky fact 8×9. Card C: a 1:5 ratio scaled. Each ~1.5in × 1.5in.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_TRICKY_BOX: keywords (cards) name the three cards.

prompts.prompt: What do you want to learn NEXT?

image_placeholders.description: Three forward-goal cards in B&W. Card A: long multiplication 23 × 45. Card B: division with remainders. Card C: '1/2 + 1/4 = ?'. Each ~1.5in × 1.5in.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_NEXT_BOX: keywords (cards) name the three forward-goal cards.

reflection_sheet.teacher_notes: Hand out at end of Lesson 5.
